notes.title: Added reset_setting functionality
notes.content:
Added a system of resetting settings for the main game in case of errors related to the save file.

To reset settings, copy the [i]reset_setting.tx[/i]t file from the [b]reset_setting[/b] folder to the root directory of the game and start the game.

notes.title: Hotfix for Dead Souls.
notes.content:
After the update of Dead Souls, some users have a problem with starting the game.
I found out that the problem is due to an error in the save file.
The only solution is to overwrite the save to Dead Souls. ːsteamsadː
Start the main game and press F6.

Special thanks for help in finding an error - SASDST.

notes.title: Big Update: New Campaign (+8 levels)
notes.content:
XXL users will get their presents few weeks earlier.
A new campaign has been added which contains 8 new levels and a new class of enemies.
In total, the game now has 50 levels, which correspond to approximately 3.5-5 hours of play.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30353377/e6506081f233369083a79a0be49f8bb489ffe4cc.png[/img]

Zombie girls now have a new pet – [b]headcrab[/b].
[b]First move:[/b] the headcrab jumps on you.
[b]Second move:[/b] it digs its claws into your head.
[b]Third move:[/b] being affected by the parasite, you start causing yourself damage, equal to your attack.

Just like when getting rid of the fishing net and the chain, you need to complete a row of tiles of the corresponding color (if there’s no concussion - hammer).

[b]Do we plan to introduce other updates?[/b]
It’s difficult to say. For the moment, only 2.5% of XXL users have provided game reviews.
It’s totally unclear whether other players are interested in the game. Sure, we have no resources for developing the game just for fifty users.
